Sheraton Phoenix Downtown History in the Making From launching the industry's first automated reservations system to being the first international hotel chain in the People’s Republic of China, we’ve led the transformation of travel around the world. Discover the New Sheraton For more than 85 years, we’ve welcomed and unified the world. Today, we continue to be the World’s Gathering Place by offering locally rooted experiences and stylish spaces to work, meet and relax. GATHERINGS BY SHERATON PUBLIC SPACES GUEST ROOMS DINING MOMENTS OF CONNECTION Gatherings by Sheraton Hosted at hotels around the world, these weekly experiences are centered on three pillars: enrichment, renewal and local stories. TIMELESS DESIGN Guest Rooms Our guest rooms deliver productivity during the day and restful refuge at night. Welcome to the New Sheraton Discover our recently transformed hotels around the globe.
